title: Grouping and Aggregating with GROUP BY
realWorldScenario: Category managers need to analyze inventory depth by viewing product counts and average pricing per category.
questionStatement: Write a query to group products by `category`, returning the `category`, `product_count` (number of products), and `avg_price` (average price rounded to 2 decimals), sorted by `product_count` descending.
starterCode:
-- Group products by category
SELECT
  category,
  COUNT(*) AS product_count,
  ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_price
FROM products
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY product_count DESC;
hints: Every column in SELECT that is not an aggregate function must appear in the GROUP BY clause.

testCases.description: Verify product catalog breakdown by category
